In [Bayou Kidz](https://bayoulifemag.com/category/bayoulife-features/bayou-kids/). We watched as Neville flags were flown around our community as a way to support this family, this school who had lost one of their own. I lost a few friends during those first few years after we lost Samuel, because I “wasn’t myself” and I “didn’t take their calls” or when I did take their call I “didn’t want to talk.” Thankfully, we found our way back to one another, but the black abyss that you are in is so encompassing and overwhelming that you don’t want to worry about making conversations about someone’s vacation or what color they are painting their kitchen.
